_doc: missed: texts that Ren'Py's translate does not extract (show text, renpy.input / notify, variables that hold a title, dialogue without a block), what is skipped (menus, screens, paths, ids, colours, data), the functions of the game that show text, writing the findings into strings blocks, the settings file.

files.root/game/script.rpy:
define mc = Character("Mia")
default title = "The Great Adventure"
default names = [
    "Indented data line here",
]
init python:
    notify("Item added to the inventory")
    notify("Quest updated for the player")
    notify("You found a hidden room")
    popup("Another message appears")
    obj.append("Not a function of the game")

label start:
    scene bg
    show text "Welcome to the game" at truecenter
    mc "Hello, how are you?"
    mc "This line has a translation block."
    mc "A line that has no block at all, honestly."
    "Narration without a block."
    $ renpy.notify("Saved the game")
    $ name = renpy.input("What is your name?")
    $ message = "You have new mail"
    menu:
        "Go left":
            jump left
        "Go right" if flag:
            jump right
    $ x = "snake_case_id"
    $ path = "images/bg.png"
    $ col = "#ff00ff"
    $ tag = "{i}Styled{/i} text here"
    $ lone = "Hello"
    $ lower = "nothing"
    $ dup = "You have new mail"
    $ t2 = 'Single quoted sentence here'

screen hud():
    text "Screen text is skipped"
    $ renpy.notify("Python in a screen")

image bg = "bg.png"
translate czech strings:
    old "never read here"
    new "x"
